description: This Dart class `SavedNewsDb` provides a persistence layer for storing and retrieving bookmarked news articles, supporting both SQLite database storage via sqflite and an in-memory fallback for environments where sqflite is unavailable. The class includes methods for database initialization, inserting/updating articles, deleting articles by headline, and fetching all saved articles.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A persistence class for managing saved news articles, supporting both local database and in-memory fallback storage.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the underlying database or switches to in-memory fallback if initialization fails.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a news article in the storage.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a stored article by its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all stored articles, sorted with newest first.
